description: This PHP source file defines the SaveSystemUserController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract controller and manages pre-render logic for system user save/edit views, determining whether a password is required based on social media authentication status, and setting up UI components accordingly.

classes.name: SaveSystemUserController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the component configuration for saving or editing a system user, including determining password requirement based on social media authentication status.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by selecting the appropriate component ('system-user-edit' or 'system-user-save') based on presence of user ID, and adds properties including whether a password is required.
